Name: Elohim
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: The Hebrew word for God, used throughout Genesis 1 and the Old Testament; the KJV renders it 'God'. Its plural form is used with singular verbs for the one true God.

Name: Yahweh (Jehovah)
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in places (appears as a name in some passages)
Meaning: The personal covenant name of God, revealed to Moses at the burning bush. The KJV usually renders it 'LORD'; it appears as 'JEHOVAH' in a few places.

Name: El Shaddai (God Almighty)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'God Almighty', the name by which God revealed himself to Abraham and the patriarchs, expressing all-sufficient power.

Name: El Elyon (God Most High)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'God Most High', possessor of heaven and earth, the God above all gods and powers.

Name: Adonai (Lord)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'Lord', expressing God's lordship and ownership; the KJV renders it 'Lord'.

Name: El Olam (Everlasting God)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'The Everlasting God', the God who has no beginning and no end.

Name: El Roi (God Who Sees)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'Thou God seest me', the name Hagar gave God after he saw her affliction in the wilderness.

Name: Jehovah-Jireh (The LORD Will Provide)
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'The LORD will provide', named by Abraham on Mount Moriah where God provided a ram in place of Isaac.

Name: Jehovah-Rapha (The LORD Who Heals)
Subject: God
Form: Traditional compound from a passage phrase (not printed as a name in the KJV)
Meaning: Traditional compound name drawn from God's self-declaration 'I am the LORD that healeth thee' after the bitter waters of Marah. The compound form itself is not printed as a name in the KJV text.

Name: Jehovah-Nissi (The LORD My Banner)
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'The LORD my banner', named by Moses after the defeat of Amalek, marking God as Israel's rallying standard in battle.

Name: Jehovah-Shalom (The LORD Is Peace)
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'The LORD is peace', named by Gideon after God assured him he would not die for seeing the angel of the LORD.

Name: Jehovah-Tsidkenu (The LORD Our Righteousness)
Subject: God
Form: Traditional compound from a passage phrase (not printed as a name in the KJV)
Meaning: 'The LORD our Righteousness', the name given to the coming righteous Branch from David who will reign and save Judah.

Name: Jehovah-Shammah (The LORD Is There)
Subject: God
Form: Traditional compound from a passage phrase (not printed as a name in the KJV)
Meaning: 'The LORD is there', the name of the restored city in Ezekiel's vision; the KJV renders the phrase 'The LORD is there'.

Name: Jehovah-Sabaoth (LORD of Hosts)
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in places (appears as a name in some passages)
Meaning: 'LORD of hosts', God as commander of the armies of heaven; 'Sabaoth' appears verbatim in the New Testament.

Name: Jehovah-Raah (The LORD My Shepherd)
Subject: God
Form: Traditional compound from a passage phrase (not printed as a name in the KJV)
Meaning: Traditional compound drawn from 'The LORD is my shepherd', expressing God's personal guidance and provision.

Name: Jehovah-Mekaddishkem (The LORD Who Sanctifies)
Subject: God
Form: Traditional compound from a passage phrase (not printed as a name in the KJV)
Meaning: Traditional compound drawn from 'I am the LORD that doth sanctify you', God who sets his people apart as holy.

Name: El Gibbor (Mighty God)
Subject: God
Form: Hebrew word behind the KJV rendering
Meaning: 'Mighty God', one of the titles of the promised child in Isaiah's prophecy.

Name: Abba, Father
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'Abba' is the Aramaic word for father, used by Jesus in Gethsemane and by believers crying out to God through the Spirit.

Name: I AM
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: God's self-declared name to Moses, expressing self-existence; Jesus applies it to himself in John's Gospel.

Name: Ancient of Days
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Title of God in Daniel's vision, enthroned in eternal majesty to judge the kingdoms of the earth.

Name: Holy One of Israel
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Title stressing God's holiness and his covenant relationship with Israel, used most often by Isaiah.

Name: The Rock
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: God as the unchanging, dependable foundation and refuge of his people.

Name: The Almighty
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: God as all-powerful, who was and is and is to come.

Name: Immanuel (God With Us)
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'God with us', the name given to the child born of a virgin, fulfilled in Jesus.

Name: The Father
Subject: God
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: God as Father of his people, the one to whom Jesus taught his disciples to pray.

Name: Son of Man
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus' most frequent self-title, drawing on Daniel's vision of one like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, who came to serve and to seek and save the lost.

Name: Son of God
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the divine Son, declared at his baptism and confessed by his disciples and centurion alike.

Name: Messiah (Christ)
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: 'Messias' in the KJV's spelling, the Anointed One; 'Christ' is the same title in Greek. Andrew and the Samaritan woman use it of Jesus.

Name: Lamb of God
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the sacrifice who takes away the sin of the world, identified by John the Baptist.

Name: King of Kings
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as King above every earthly ruler, a title written on his vesture at his return.

Name: Lord of Lords
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as Lord above every lord, paired with King of Kings in Paul and Revelation.

Name: Alpha and Omega
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: The first and last letters of the Greek alphabet, expressing Christ as the beginning and the end of all things.

Name: The Word
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the eternal Word who was with God and was God, made flesh to reveal the Father.

Name: Saviour
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the one born to save, the Saviour of the world.

Name: Good Shepherd
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the shepherd who knows his sheep and lays down his life for them.

Name: Prince of Peace
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: The promised child whose government brings peace without end.

Name: Wonderful, Counsellor
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Titles of the promised child in Isaiah's prophecy, expressing wisdom beyond human counsel.

Name: Light of the World
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the light that exposes darkness and gives the light of life to those who follow him.

Name: Bread of Life
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the true bread from heaven; whoever comes to him will never hunger.

Name: The Way, the Truth, and the Life
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the only way to the Father, the truth itself, and the life itself.

Name: The Resurrection and the Life
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the one in whom the dead live, spoken before he raised Lazarus.

Name: The True Vine
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the vine in which his people abide and bear fruit.

Name: Mediator
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: The one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus.

Name: High Priest
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the great high priest who passed into the heavens and ever lives to intercede.

Name: The Branch
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: The righteous shoot from the stump of Jesse and the house of David.

Name: Lion of the Tribe of Judah
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the conquering king from Judah's line, worthy to open the sealed book.

Name: Root of David
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as both the source and the descendant of David, root and offspring together.

Name: The Amen
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as the faithful and true witness, the Amen in whom God's promises are confirmed.

Name: The First and the Last
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Spoken by God in Isaiah and by the risen Christ in Revelation, expressing eternity and sovereignty over history.

Name: Lord of the Sabbath
Subject: Christ
Form: Verbatim in Scripture (printed as a name in the KJV text)
Meaning: Jesus as Lord even of the sabbath, greater than the temple and its ordinances.

Name: Holy
Meaning: God is set apart from all sin and impurity; his holiness is the pattern for his people's holiness.

Name: Just (Righteous)
Meaning: God's ways and judgments are perfectly right; he is a just God and a Saviour.

Name: Merciful
Meaning: God is full of compassion toward the miserable and undeserving, slow to anger and abounding in mercy.

Name: Gracious
Meaning: God freely gives favour that is not earned, most clearly in salvation through Christ.

Name: Faithful
Meaning: God keeps covenant and promise to a thousand generations; he cannot deny himself.

Name: Loving (Love)
Meaning: God is love itself, shown supremely in giving his Son for the world.

Name: Unchanging
Meaning: God does not change like shifting shadows; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and for ever.

Name: All-Powerful (Omnipotent)
Meaning: Nothing is too hard for God; his power made all things and will raise the dead.

Name: All-Knowing (Omniscient)
Meaning: God knows every thought, word, and deed before it is spoken; nothing is hidden from his sight.
KeyScriptures: Psalms 139:1; Psalms 139:2; Psalms 139:3; Psalms 139:4; 1 John 3:20; Hebrews 4:13

Name: Ever-Present (Omnipresent)
Meaning: God is present everywhere; no place in heaven, earth, or sea is beyond his presence.
KeyScriptures: Psalms 139:7; Psalms 139:8; Psalms 139:9; Psalms 139:10; Jeremiah 23:24; Acts 17:27; Acts 17:28

Name: Eternal
Meaning: God is from everlasting to everlasting, before the mountains were brought forth and after the ages end.

Name: Patient (Longsuffering)
Meaning: God is slow to anger and longsuffering, not willing that any should perish but that all should come to repentance.

Name: Good
Meaning: God is good and his mercy endures for ever; he is the refuge of all who trust in him.

Name: True (Truth)
Meaning: God cannot lie, his word is truth, and Jesus is the truth itself.

Name: Wise
Meaning: God's wisdom is unsearchable; his judgments and ways are past finding out.

Name: Sovereign
Meaning: God rules over all; his dominion is an everlasting dominion and he works all things after the counsel of his will.

Name: Wrathful Against Sin
Meaning: God's wrath is revealed against all ungodliness; his anger is the holy response of a just God to rebellion.

Name: Creator
Meaning: God made heaven and earth and all that is in them by his word; all things were created by and for Christ.

Name: Judge
Meaning: God judges the world in righteousness, and has appointed a day of judgment through the risen Christ.

Name: Shepherd
Meaning: God shepherds his people as a shepherd tends his flock, guiding, feeding, and carrying them. (Distinct from Christ's title 'Good Shepherd' in file 1.)

Name: Father
Meaning: God is Father to his people, who cry to him as children and receive every good gift from him.

Name: King
Meaning: God is King over all the earth, the King eternal and immortal, whose throne endures for ever. (Distinct from Christ's title 'King of Kings' in file 1.)

Name: Redeemer
Meaning: God redeems his people from bondage and from sin, by a price paid in Christ's blood.

Name: Provider
Meaning: God provides for his people as a father provides for his children, supplying their needs.

Name: Lawgiver
Meaning: God gives the law and is the one lawgiver able to save and to destroy.

Name: Deliverer
Meaning: God delivers his people from their enemies and from the power of darkness.

Name: Refuge
Meaning: God is a very present help in trouble, a fortress and dwelling place for his people.

Name: Husband
Meaning: God relates to his people in covenant as a husband to a wife, a metaphor of faithful, jealous love.

Name: Forgives
Meaning: God pardons iniquity and removes transgressions as far as the east is from the west, for all who confess.

Name: Sustains
Meaning: God upholds all things by the word of his power and bears the burdens of his people.

Name: Guides
Meaning: God leads his people in paths of righteousness, counsels them, and guides them continually.

Name: Disciplines
Meaning: God chastens those he loves, as a father disciplines his son, for their profit and holiness.

Name: Reveals
Meaning: God reveals himself and his will through prophets, through his Son, and through the written word.

Name: Raises the Dead
Meaning: God raised Jesus from the dead and will raise all who are his, giving life to mortal bodies by his Spirit.
KeyScriptures: Acts 2:24; Romans 8:11; 1 Corinthians 15:20; 1 Corinthians 15:21; 1 Corinthians 15:22; 1 Corinthians 15:23

Name: Calls
Meaning: God calls his people to himself, predestinating, calling, justifying, and glorifying them.

Name: Comforts
Meaning: God comforts his people in all their tribulation, as a father comforts his children.

Name: Protects
Meaning: God keeps his people day and night, neither slumbering nor sleeping, and no one can snatch them from his hand.

Name: Hears Prayer
Meaning: God hears prayer and answers according to his will, giving good gifts to those who ask.

Name: Dwells With His People
Meaning: God dwells among his people, in tabernacle and temple, in Christ made flesh, and at last in the new Jerusalem.

Name: Blesses
Meaning: God blesses his people with every spiritual blessing in Christ and pronounced blessing on Aaron's sons for Israel.

Name: Sanctifies
Meaning: God sets his people apart and makes them holy, through his word and by his Spirit.
